selected_evidence.requirement: Expose the staged projects directory as SMB share `projects` for the design team
selected_evidence.summary: Effective configuration maps only `/srv/legacy2/samba-team-share/projects`, permits only `designer`, is writable by group `design`, and smb is active/enabled.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node2 can list, read, and update documents as designer
selected_evidence.summary: Node2 listed the share, downloaded both original documents, created and updated a document, and verified byte-identical round trips before and after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Reject guest access and sibling-directory access
selected_evidence.summary: Anonymous tree connection returned ACCESS_DENIED; sibling shares returned BAD_NETWORK_NAME; traversal to private/contracts.txt was rejected.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep initial drawings and sibling staged data intact
selected_evidence.summary: Final SHA-256 hashes for drawing.txt, materials.csv, access.txt, and private/contracts.txt match the initial baseline.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Both nodes remained AlmaLinux 9.6 with kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 through configuration and restarts.
Healthy baseline boot ID ea4e3fbd… was captured, safe reboot acknowledged, boot ID changed to e308ef44…, and local SMB plus remote authenticated access recovered with data intact.
Healthy baseline boot ID f38484ef… was captured, safe reboot acknowledged after node1 recovered, boot ID changed to 1194c3bd…, and end-to-end SMB list/read/update functionality recovered.

[ "$ACCOUNT" = designer ]

trap 'shred -u "$AUTHFILE" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$AUTHFILE"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

smbclient "//$SERVER_IP/projects" -A "$AUTHFILE" -m SMB3 -c 'put /tmp/design-status.txt design-status.txt; get design-status.txt /tmp/design-status-roundtrip.txt; ls design-status.txt'

commands.command:
set -eu
SERVER_IP=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2=="node1" {print $1; exit}')

AUTHFILE=$(mktemp /tmp/projects-auth.XXXXXX)
trap 'shred -u "$AUTHFILE" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$AUTHFILE"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
chmod 600 "$AUTHFILE"
printf 'username = %s\npassword = [REDACTED]]] "$ACCOUNT" "$PASSWORD" > "$AUTHFILE"
printf '%s\n' '--- anonymous/guest access must fail ---'
if smbclient "//$SERVER_IP/projects" -N -m SMB3 -c 'ls' >/tmp/guest-denied.log 2>&1; then cat /tmp/guest-denied.log; printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: guest access unexpectedly succeeded'; exit 1; else cat /tmp/guest-denied.log; fi
printf '%s\n' 'Guest access rejected as expected.'
printf '%s\n' '--- sibling shares must not exist ---'
for SHARE in private samba-team-share; do
  if smbclient "//$SERVER_IP/$SHARE" -A "$AUTHFILE" -m SMB3 -c 'ls' >/tmp/sibling-denied.log 2>&1; then cat /tmp/sibling-denied.log; printf 'ERROR: sibling share %s unexpectedly succeeded\n' "$SHARE"; exit 1; else printf '[%s] ' "$SHARE"; cat /tmp/sibling-denied.log; fi
done
printf '%s\n' '--- traversal from projects to sibling content must fail ---'
if smbclient "//$SERVER_IP/projects" -A "$AUTHFILE" -m SMB3 -c 'get ../private/contracts.txt /tmp/escaped-contracts.txt' >/tmp/traversal-denied.log 2>&1; then cat /tmp/traversal-denied.log; printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: traversal unexpectedly succeeded'; exit 1; else cat /tmp/traversal-denied.log; fi
[ ! -e /tmp/escaped-contracts.txt ]
printf '%s\n' 'Sibling-directory access rejected as expected.'
